verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents native bulk operations. It supports patch-by-filter and delete-by-filter across all matching documents, column-based batch upserts, and conditional writes. Server-side namespace copies and copy-on-write branching can run in the background via `Prefer: respond-async`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk operations at scale, and documented batch size limits or throughput for bulk writes.
